title: Noor and the Echo
author: Elodie Eriksen
blurb: Kestrel Montrose, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
